summary: Retest of iteration_52 HIGH items. Code: preserve_pose is now stored on tryon docs (server.py:2021) and grid outfit docs (:3069). _tryon_retry (:3391) and _outfit_retry (:3424) prepend POSE_RULE when doc.preserve_pose is set. The PHONE_RULE header says it overrides other instructions, and it is appended last, after RETRY_REASONS. QC asks for 'missing garment' and _fix_prompt allows garment fixes. Unit tests: 12/12 pass (3 new ones in test_phone_hand_rule.py). I ran 5 REAL renders, one after another. (1) Pose single try-on on the Wikimedia hotel mirror selfie + white tee: 128s. preserve_pose=True is on the doc and hand_boxes phone=[true,false]. The PHONE IS REMOVED, the right hand hangs relaxed with 5 fingers, and the wallet/hat hand is OK. The watch moved to the other wrist again. An unfilled flat pad band remains at the top. (2) Free retry on that try-on (reason mani_viso): 102s. The job finished, retry_used/previous_result_path are set, and a 2nd retry returns 409. BUT THE PHONE IS BACK IN THE RIGHT HAND, at face height as in the original, and the original black jacket came back too. Logs: QC attempt 1 = 'tucked, malformed fingers'; after fix pass 1, QC attempt 2 = 'smartphone still present in hand'. So the fix pass re-introduces the phone, and _qc's score (3*garments+3*face+2*hands) cannot tell a phone apart from a tuck: the phone image (score 5) beat the phone-free image with bad fingers (score 3) and was returned. The same thing happened in render (1): after fix 1 QC said 'smartphone still visible'. (3) Pose Multibrand grid (top=white tee, bottom=denim shorts) on the Unsplash street pose: 41s. QC PASSED ON THE FIRST TRY, but THE SHORTS WERE NOT APPLIED: long jeans are still worn and the old denim jacket is still over the tee. (4) Outfit free retry (reason capo): 131s, and POSE_RULE is applied from the doc. The shorts are now applied, the tee is untucked and the jacket is removed. BUT the pose and identity degraded: a floating/severed hand with blur on the head (QC flagged it twice and the fixes failed), the head pose and expression changed, the other hand is now in a pocket, framing changed, and new purple/yellow Nike sneakers were invented although no shoes were requested. (5) Avatar regression (preserve_pose=False): 143s. The phone stays in the hand and both hands are pasted back as before. A NEW visible defect: a rectangular skin-coloured patch on the white tee below the phone hand. The hand paste used shift up to -99px, seam 23 passed the 28 threshold, and QC flagged a 'rectangular skin cutout artifact' twice, but the fix passes cannot remove it because finalize re-pastes it. Cleanup: the 2 tryons were deleted via the API. The outfit was deleted via mongo because no DELETE /api/outfits endpoint exists.

critical.endpoint: tryon_quality.render fix pass + best selection (used by POST /api/tryons/{id}/retry and the first generation)
critical.issue: Phone removal is not reliable. The fix pass gets IMAGE 2 = the original photo (with the phone) and reintroduces the phone (seen 2 of 2 times in this run). best_score treats 'phone visible' as just garments_ok=false (+3), so a phone image can beat a phone-free image with bad fingers and be returned. Result: the free retry of a phone selfie returned the phone in hand (plus the original jacket). Fix: when SMARTPHONE REMOVAL is active, (a) always put the remove-phone line in _fix_prompt (not only when issues mention it), (b) add a separate phone_present key to QC that vetoes the image (score -inf), or never accept a candidate with a phone, (c) consider masking/cropping the phone hand in IMAGE 2 for the fix pass.

QC passed on the first try although the shorts were not applied (2 of 2 runs across iterations). RCA: grid items have generic names ('bottom: Pantaloni / Bottom; top: Maglia / Top'), and _qc only receives the person photo and the result, not the garment images. QC therefore cannot know that shorts were requested, and 'Pantaloni' even matches the old long jeans. Fix: pass the garment images (downscaled) to _qc and _fix_prompt, or auto-describe each grid garment (e.g. 'light-blue ripped denim shorts') and use that in garments_txt and the layer_lines.

minor.issue: FIX_SYSTEM still says 'corrections to face and hands only, and never change, add or remove any clothing'. The _fix_prompt KEEP block says 'Never remove, add or swap a garment, INCLUDING the trousers' and lists the requested garments as 'currently worn'. This contradicts the new missing-garment/leftover-layer/untuck instructions. The tuck stayed in 3 of 3 pose renders even after the fix passes. The render() docstring is outdated.

The retry applied the garments, but the pose and identity were not preserved: a floating hand with blur on the head, a changed head pose, the other hand moved into a pocket, changed framing, and invented shoes (Nike Dunk) although only top+bottom were requested. QC flagged it twice and the fixes failed.

A rectangular skin patch was pasted over the new white tee below the phone hand. The hand box includes bare chest skin from the original, the shift went up to -99px and seam 23 passed the 28 threshold. QC detected it twice, but the fix pass output is re-pasted by finalize, so it can never be fixed. Consider a tighter paste mask (skin-segmented) or rejecting the paste when QC reports a cutout artifact.
Flat head_lock pad bands were left untrimmed in the pose single result (top band) and the retry (bottom band, with the watermark sitting on it).
Says '(phone held as in IMAGE 1)'. PHONE_RULE comes later and claims to override it, but the retry text should be conditional on there being no phone rule.
The wristwatch moves from the phone hand to the other wrist (2 of 2 iterations). The shoulder-bag strap disappears.
There is no DELETE endpoint for outfits (cleanup had to be done via mongo).

action_items: HIGH: Make phone removal survive the QC fix loop: always instruct phone removal in _fix_prompt when SMARTPHONE REMOVAL is active, and add a QC phone_present veto so a candidate with a phone can never be chosen as best
HIGH: Give QC/fix the actual garment images or descriptive garment names for grid items (currently 'Pantaloni / Bottom'), so a missing garment (shorts) is detected and fixed
Align FIX_SYSTEM and the _fix_prompt KEEP block with the allowed garment fixes (they currently forbid any clothing change)
Avatar mode: prevent the rectangular skin patch from hand-paste boxes on large shifts (tighter mask, or a stricter seam/shift threshold)
Fix untrimmed pad bands; make the mani_viso retry text conditional on there being no phone
critical_code_review_comments: Retry wiring is correct: extra = POSE_RULE(if doc.preserve_pose) + RETRY_REASONS. _lock_hands sees POSE_RULE in extra and therefore posed=True, the phone hand is not pasted and PHONE_RULE is appended last.
Copylook retry passes POSE_RULE only if a look doc has preserve_pose. Copylook docs don't set it, so this is unaffected.
Old tryon/outfit docs without preserve_pose default to False on retry (acceptable).
_qc score weights: phone/tuck/missing garment all share garments_ok, so it cannot rank by severity.
server.py is 3456 lines; it should be split.

success_rate.backend: Unit 12/12. Real renders 5/5 completed, but only 2/5 met the requirements: the pose single and the avatar (the avatar has a new patch artifact). The pose retry returned the phone, the grid ignored the shorts, and the outfit retry broke the pose.

seed_data_creation: None persistent. 2 tryons were deleted via the API and 1 outfit via mongo. No book entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Images are in /tmp (phone_selfie.jpg, pose_hip.jpg, tee.jpg, shorts.jpg) and copies are in /app/test_reports/iteration_52_imgs. Usage: python tests/run_pose_retry_render.py single (pose phone try-on) | retry <tryon_id> mani_viso | oretry <outfit_id> capo; python tests/run_pose_phone_render.py grid|avatar. Export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL first. Do NOT edit files in /app/backend/tests while a render runs (WatchFiles reload kills the job). The backend log lines 'quality check failed (attempt n)' show the QC loop.
rca of the issue: Phone back after retry: the retry prompt correctly contains POSE_RULE + PHONE_RULE, and the first generation was phone-free (QC attempt 1 did not mention a phone). The fix pass (_fix_prompt with IMAGE 2 = the original photo holding the phone) restored the phone, and the best-of selection preferred that image (score 5 vs 3). Grid shorts: garments_txt holds only the generic slot names and QC has no garment images, so QC accepts the long jeans as 'Pantaloni' and no fix is triggered.
